D: A Kree warrior crashes into 1990s Earth and starts piecing together who she really is.
P: Serve the snacks when Carol crashes through the roof of the video store.
S: Carol crashing through the roof of a video store in 1995
Popcorn popped in a big lidded pot, tossed with plenty of melted butter and fine salt, poured into big tubs like the rental store counter.
Goose the cat, who is really a flerken
Salmon cut into bite-sized pieces, dusted in flour, dipped in egg and panko, baked at 220C for 12 minutes until golden, with tartare sauce to dip.
Crab meat bound with mayo, mustard, spring onion and breadcrumbs, pan-fried until golden, with remoulade.
M: catching up with Maria and Monica at home
Chicken and smoked sausage simmered in a dark roux with okra, capsicum, onion and celery, over rice.
W: Sweet pastry blind baked, filled with a lemon curd of juice, zest, sugar, cornflour, yolks and butter, topped with meringue and browned at 200C for 6 minutes.
K: Orange and pineapple juice topped with lemonade, a few drops of blue colouring swirled in.

s.note: Carol crashing through the roof of a video store in 1995
s.how: Heat a splash of oil in a big lidded pot and pop 100g popping corn, shaking often. Melt 80g butter and pour it all over the popcorn while tossing. Season with fine sea salt and pour into big tubs like the counter at a nineties video store.

s.note: Goose the cat, who is really a flerken
s.how: Cut 600g salmon fillet into bite-sized pieces. Dust in flour, dip in beaten egg and press into panko breadcrumbs. Spread on a lined tray, spray with a little oil and bake at 220C for 12 minutes until golden. Serve with tartare sauce. Keep them away from the cat.

m.note: catching up with Maria and Monica at home
m.how: Cook 60g flour in 60ml oil, stirring for 20 minutes until dark brown. Add diced onion, green capsicum and celery and soften. Add 600g chicken thighs, 300g sliced smoked sausage, okra and 1.5L water. Simmer an hour and serve over long grain rice.

w.how: Blind bake a sweet shortcrust case. Whisk the juice and zest of 4 lemons, 200g sugar, 4 tbsp cornflour, 4 yolks and 60g butter over heat until thick, then pour into the case. Whisk the 4 whites with 150g sugar to glossy peaks, pile on top and bake at 200C for 6 minutes.

d.how: Pour 1L orange juice and 1L pineapple juice into a big jug with ice. Top with 1L cold lemonade. Add a few drops of blue food colouring and give it one slow swirl so it streaks through. Pour into glasses and serve straight away.
